name: Split-layout tabs with fading media pane
purpose: Shows how one product serves several teams or use cases: pick a team on one side, see its visual and a short pitch with a demo CTA.
description: Centred header (H2 + grey intro), then a 37rem-tall split: a 40% column of large text tabs (inactive dimmed, current white with the green tab-chip and 2rem indent, hairline rule under each) above a per-tab paragraph + button, and a 55% media pane on the opposite side that cross-fades per tab. `variant` (same content shape): 'base' (/nova; tabs left, 16:9 video pane right, 1-line H2 with italic phrase, 16px intro) and 'reversed' (/lms/mentoring-software; pane left, tabs right, image pane, 2-line H2, 18px intro, blue 'brand' buttons). <=767 stacks: tabs become a horizontally scrolling row, pane 60dvh, copy below.
